## What

Describe the change in two or three sentences.

## Why

What mistake does this prevent, or what allocation problem does it solve? Link
the issue with `Closes #N`.

## Scope

- [ ] Specification
- [ ] JSON Schema
- [ ] Validator
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests or CI

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run check:valid` exits 0
- [ ] `npm run check:invalid` exits non-zero
- [ ] New behaviour has a test

## Notes for review

Anything a reviewer should know, including spec version implications.
